dogecoin.text: @SymoneBeez @OddSeller Facts.  Elon wants to scrutinize excess spending in some areas, cut, and free up money for the US to invest more aggressively in space.  SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and others will benefit.  Instead of chasing Dogecoin, we need to be investing in space.
